description.value: A multimodal voxel-based study of gray matter atrophy and FDG hypometabolism in patients with behavioral variant frontotemporal lobar degeneration compared with healthy controls, including voxelwise correlations and direct MRI-PET comparisons.

spans.text: In this study, we aimed to show the patterns of GM atrophy and hypometabolism in a sample of 15 patients with the behavioral variant of FTLD (bv-FTD), compared to 15 healthy controls

description.value: A study comparing patients with probable bv-FTD and matched healthy controls using structural MRI and FDG-PET.

spans.text: The participants underwent structural magnetic resonance imaging and F-fluorodeoxyglucose (FDG) positron emission tomography examinations.

value: The pairwise intermodality correlation analyses revealed significant correlations between GM atrophy and hypometabolism in the patient group, mainly involving the frontal cortex, the right temporal pole, and the left anterior cingulate cortex.

This voxelwise correlation may indicate that changes in these areas share common mechanisms, and more specifically that the loss of GM volume is primarily dependent on neuronal death, with neither compensatory nor disconnection mechanisms at work.
